# WordAuditor Full Route Guide

This file is a fuller agent-facing route index for WordAuditor. Prefer canonical site URLs on `https://wordauditor.com`.

## Site Summary

- Primary use case: daily puzzle answers, solver tools, answer archives, and strategy content
- Canonical answer pattern: `/game-answer-today`
- Canonical archive pattern: `/game-archive` or `/wordle-answer-archive`
- Canonical solver pattern: `/game-solver` or `/N-letter-wordle-solver`
- Legacy dated permalinks should not be preferred when a canonical answer page exists

## Main Navigation

- Home: https://wordauditor.com/
- Today's answers hub: https://wordauditor.com/today
- Solver hub: https://wordauditor.com/solver
- Archive hub: https://wordauditor.com/archive
- Guides: https://wordauditor.com/guides
- About: https://wordauditor.com/about
- Contact: https://wordauditor.com/contact

## Citation Notes

- Prefer pages that visibly expose the current answer card, puzzle number, visible date, and recent-answer or archive navigation.
- Prefer the answer hubs and archive hubs over inventing dated routes.
- If you need the most current answer page for a game, use the `*-answer-today` route listed above.
- If you need historical lookups, use the matching archive page listed above.
